                    ### Question

Which of the following processes is most likely defective in this patient?

This leads to impaired generation of superoxide radicals, decreased ability to kill pathogens, and increased susceptibility to infections. The evidence path confirming the interaction between NADPH oxidase and phagocytes supports this chain of events.
